anatomy_notes.source: Own chr567 model; PMDO10013; 18px Small target. Fixed extent1.138 and +0.5s native loop phase; no raster resize or frame fit.

anatomy_notes.markers: J_ago projected eye midpoint, J_center body, real ear roots J_mimi_L1/R1 as PMDO hand-field substitutes, not literal hands.
anatomy_notes.motion: bn01 native 2.00000013s loop; 0.5s phase-shifted quarter samples/30 ticks; final 1.999s wraps near 0s endpoint.
